body:
Parked on 17 Oct 2026 at the human's request until the business problem is strengthened. Do not start until the human un-parks it.

Source: Ask-the-Expert session audit (canvas ask-the-expert-compliance-audit), auto-transcript of YouTube _75UeGNj1GY.

Agent work:
1. Move runnable gcloud deploy commands (--set-env-vars, --set-secrets) out of the public repo into an ignored local runbook; docs/deploy.md keeps a settings table only (speaker at 27:26: do not paste deploy commands or environment variables). python scripts/check_deploy_docs.py must still pass.
2. README: add a Data and guardrails section (data sources, labels, every guardrail) and an Evaluator limits list (30 extracts per minute, 60 s agent timeout, first-load cold start).
3. Draft the pitch deck (PDF) and the portal description of Google Cloud usage (Cloud Run, Gemini on Agent Platform, ADK, Secret Manager).
4. After deploy: live receipt extract, live Explain this plan, measured latency, judge URL in README.

Human work: reopen billing; make the GitHub repo public; confirm the video length on the portal (host said at least 3 to 4 minutes, FAQ notes say under 3); confirm every team member is a professional and pick the two travelers; record the video on the live URL at clear volume.

Acceptance criteria:
1. No deploy command is tracked. Verify: git grep -nE "gcloud run deploy|--set-env-vars|--set-secrets" -- '*.md' returns nothing
2. Deploy docs still pass. Verify: python scripts/check_deploy_docs.py
3. README sections exist. Verify: python scripts/check_judge_readme.py
title: PARKED: submission hygiene, judge docs, deck, and portal description
